neighbours.label: the noun after an evaluative 'best', 'better' or 'good' that frames a highlight about to be revealed (Best part?, the best thing is, good news), as against the same nouns used plainly and 'best' with ordinary nouns
fire: We repainted the whole kitchen in a day. Best part? It cost almost nothing.
The new library opened downtown, and the best thing is that it stays open late.
I have some good news for everyone who signed up early.
The trip was lovely. The best part was the boat ride at sunset.
Hold on, I have even better news than that.
The app works offline. Best thing about it? No ads at all.
If that wasn't good news enough, the tickets are half price.
We moved to a smaller flat, and the best part is the garden.
quiet: We repainted the whole kitchen in a day, and it cost almost nothing.
The new library opened downtown, and it stays open late.
I have some spare tickets for everyone who signed up early.
The trip was lovely. The boat ride at sunset was calm.
Hold on, I have to fix the front part of the bike first.
The app works offline and has no ads at all.
She met her best friend at the station before the show.
We moved to a smaller flat, and the news reached us there.
